items.title: File Widerspruch against rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter states dispatch date (Versandt am) as Samstag, 21.11.2026, and that the decision is deemed notified ('gilt ... als bekannt gegeben') on the 4th day after the stated dispatch day. Counting from 21.11.2026: +1=22.11 (Sun), +2=23.11 (Mon), +3=24.11 (Tue), +4=25.11.2026 (Wed) -> Bekanntgabe (deemed notification) = 25.11.2026. 25.11.2026 is a Wednesday, not a weekend/holiday, so no shift needed for the notification fiction itself. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs per Section 187(1) BGB (applied via Section 64 SGG): the day of notification (25.11.2026) is not counted, the period starts 26.11.2026, and per Section 188(2) BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering (notification) day, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 (1. Weihnachtstag, Friday) is a statutory public holiday in NRW, so under Section 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day. 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag) is also an NRW public holiday and falls on a Saturday; 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; the next business day is Monday 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter applies a 4-day notification fiction after dispatch ('vierter Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag'), which differs from the standard 3-day rule under Section 37(2) SGB X; the computed deadline relies on the wording actually printed in this letter and should be double-checked against the original document if any doubt exists.
